reason: NO_CHANGE. All 3 support pairs consistently show motion blur + JPEG with no noise and no global step. The only R1 correction hypothesis (motion severity 4 -> 5) is supported by bias/threshold re-interpretation (gm_ratio upward-biased by post-blur JPEG; pair2 near sev5 cutoff; angle-agnostic spectral_slope matched sev5 twice), but fails the mandated PSNR decision rule on all 3 pairs: R0 control mean 26.05 dB vs candidate mean 25.19 dB (delta -0.86 dB < +2 dB; per-pair +8.68/-12.74/+1.49) and no draw > 40 dB. Because x_distortion blur_motion draws the angle U(-90,90) per apply, the same pipeline spans 20.2-32.3 dB across draws; this within-pipeline variance exceeds the sev4/sev5 effect, so single-draw cross-support PSNR cannot arbitrate severity. Per protocol, insufficient evidence -> NO_CHANGE; R1 pipeline is item-for-item identical to R0.
limitations: k=3 pairs used (all available). Motion-angle randomness limits PSNR-based severity resolution; a >40 dB aligned-angle draw is a lottery and was not pursued. Severity 4 vs 5 remains the open uncertainty carried into R2/training arbitration.
